thoughts.name: ramble-restart
thoughts.text: Okay so, um, in ledgerly, I want, no wait, let me start over. The invoice list, the one on the dashboard, it loads everything at once and that's, like, really slow when a customer has a few thousand invoices. So can you make it paginate, fifty per page I think, yeah fifty, and keep the current sort order. Oh and don't touch the API, the API stays as it is, do it in the frontend only.

thoughts.name: reference-before
thoughts.text: That animation thing from before, on the notch, it still stutters when I'm on the external monitor. Can you look at that again, and this time actually test it on the external display before you say it's done.

thoughts.name: goal-shift
thoughts.text: For folio, I think the hero image should be lazy loaded, because the page is slow. Hmm, actually no, the image is fine, the real problem is the fonts, they block rendering. So forget the image, make the fonts load without blocking the first paint, and keep the two font families we have, don't swap them for system fonts.

thoughts.text: I need a command in kiln that rebuilds only the pages that changed since the last build, um, it has to work without git though, because some people use it on plain folders, so compare file hashes or timestamps or whatever you think, and, yeah, print how many pages it skipped at the end.
